chunks: And in another narration, he عليه السلام said:

Indeed, your triple divorce does not become permissible for others, but their divorce becomes permissible for you, because you do not regard the triple divorce as anything, whereas they deem it binding.

key_terms.الثَّلَاثَ: the triple form of divorce, meaning threefold divorce
key_terms.لَا تَرَوْنَ: you do not consider or hold the view
key_terms.يُوجِبُونَهَا: they affirm it as binding or legally consequential

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the legal status of triple divorce for those who do and do not consider it valid?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling concerning triple divorce and its differing legal effect between communities with different juridical views. It states that the ruling follows each side's doctrinal position regarding whether a threefold pronouncement counts as an effective divorce.
